meals.name: Sticky Sesame Chicken with Roasted Broccoli and Rice
meals.description: Quick and flavorful chicken pieces coated in a sweet and savory sesame sauce, served with roasted broccoli and steamed rice, ready in about 40 minutes.
instructions: Cook jasmine rice according to package instructions. While rice cooks, preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Toss broccoli florets with 1 tablespoon olive oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet; roast for 15-20 minutes until tender-crisp.
Cut chicken breast into 1-inch pieces. In a medium bowl, whisk together soy sauce, sesame oil, honey, minced garlic, grated ginger, cornstarch, rice vinegar, and red pepper flakes to make the sauce.

Heat 1 tablespoon vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add chicken pieces and cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until browned and cooked through. Remove chicken from skillet and set aside.
Pour the sauce into the same skillet and bring to a simmer over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened, about 2-3 minutes. Return cooked chicken to the skillet, tossing to coat evenly.
Serve the sticky sesame chicken immediately over steamed jasmine rice, garnished with sesame seeds, alongside the roasted broccoli.

meals.name: Quick Lemon Herb Salmon with Roasted Asparagus and Quinoa
meals.description: Pan-seared salmon fillets infused with lemon and herbs, served alongside tender roasted asparagus and fluffy quinoa, all prepared in under 30 minutes.
instructions: Cook quinoa according to package instructions. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Trim the woody ends off the asparagus spears.
On a baking sheet, toss asparagus with 1 tablespoon olive oil, salt, and pepper. Roast for 10-12 minutes until tender-crisp.
Pat salmon fillets dry with paper towels. Season both sides with salt, pepper, minced garlic, dill, and parsley. Slice the lemon into thin rounds.

Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil and 1 tablespoon butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Once butter is melted and foamy, add salmon fillets skin-side down (if applicable). Place lemon slices on top of salmon. Cook for 4-6 minutes per side, depending on thickness, until salmon is cooked through and flakes easily.
Serve salmon immediately with roasted asparagus and quinoa.

meals.name: One-Pan Beef and Bell Pepper Skillet with Rice
meals.description: A quick and flavorful skillet meal featuring lean ground beef, colorful bell peppers, and savory spices, served over steamed rice, ready in about 30 minutes.

ingredients.name: Mixed bell peppers (e.g., red, yellow, green)

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add ground beef and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned. Drain any excess fat.
Add chopped onion, sliced bell peppers, and minced garlic to the skillet. Cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are slightly softened.

Stir in diced tomatoes (with their juice), beef broth, cumin, chili powder, and paprika. Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and cook for 10-15 minutes, allowing flavors to meld and vegetables to fully tenderize.
Uncover and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes if needed to reduce liquid slightly. Taste and adjust seasonings with salt and pepper as desired.
Serve the beef and bell pepper skillet over warm jasmine rice, garnished with fresh cilantro.

meals.name: Slow Cooker BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwiches with Creamy Coleslaw
meals.description: Tender, slow-cooked pork shoulder simmered in a tangy BBQ sauce, served on soft buns with a creamy homemade coleslaw, with minimal active cooking time.
instructions: Season the pork shoulder generously with salt and pepper. Place sliced onion and minced garlic in the bottom of a 6-quart (or larger) slow cooker.

Place the seasoned pork shoulder on top of the onions and garlic. In a separate bowl, whisk together 1 cup BBQ sauce, apple cider vinegar, brown sugar, mustard powder, Worcestershire sauce, and hot sauce (if using). Pour the sauce over the pork.
Cover the slow cooker and cook on low for 6-8 hours, or on high for 3-4 hours, until the pork is fork-tender and easily shreds.

While pork cooks, prepare the coleslaw: In a medium bowl, combine coleslaw mix, mayonnaise, 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar, 1 tablespoon brown sugar, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Mix well and refrigerate until serving.

Once pork is cooked, remove it from the slow cooker and shred it using two forks. Discard any large pieces of fat. Return shredded pork to the slow cooker and stir to combine with the cooking liquids and sauce. Serve the BBQ pulled pork warm on hamburger buns, topped with creamy coleslaw.

meals.name: Sheet Pan Lemon Herb Chicken and Potatoes
meals.description: Chicken thighs and bite-sized potatoes roasted together with lemon, garlic, and savory herbs for a simple, flavorful meal with easy cleanup, ready in about 40 minutes.

ingredients.name: Baby potatoes or Yukon Gold potatoes

instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper for easier cleanup.
In a large bowl, combine quartered potatoes with 2 tablespoons olive oil, minced garlic, dried rosemary, dried thyme, dried oregano, salt, and pepper. Toss to coat evenly.
Spread the seasoned potatoes in a single layer on one half of the prepared baking sheet. Roast for 15 minutes.

While potatoes roast, pat chicken thighs dry and season with salt and pepper. After 15 minutes, add chicken thighs and lemon slices to the other half of the baking sheet. Drizzle chicken with remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil.

Return to oven and roast for another 20-25 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through (internal temperature 165°F / 74°C) and potatoes are tender and golden. Garnish with fresh parsley before serving.

meals.name: Hearty Lentil Shepherd's Pie
meals.description: A comforting vegetarian shepherd's pie with a savory lentil and vegetable filling, topped with creamy mashed potatoes and baked until golden, ready in about 70 minutes.
instructions: Peel and quarter potatoes; place in a large pot, cover with cold salted water, and bring to a boil. Cook for 15-20 minutes until fork-tender. Drain, then mash with butter and milk until smooth. Season with salt and pepper. Set aside.

While potatoes cook, rinse lentils. In a large pot or Dutch oven, heat 2 tablespoons olive oil over medium heat. Add chopped onion, carrots, and celery; cook for 5-7 minutes until softened. Add minced garlic, dried thyme, and dried rosemary; cook for 1 minute until fragrant.

Stir in tomato paste, lentils, vegetable broth, and Worcestershire sauce. Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 20-25 minutes, or until lentils are tender. Stir in frozen peas and cook for 2-3 minutes until heated through. Taste and adjust seasonings.
Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Transfer the lentil mixture to an oven-safe baking dish (approx. 9x13 inch). Spread the mashed potatoes evenly over the top of the lentil mixture.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the filling is bubbly and the mashed potato topping is golden brown. Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.

meals.name: Classic Meatloaf with Mashed Potatoes and Green Beans
meals.description: A classic, tender meatloaf topped with a tangy glaze, served with creamy mashed potatoes and crisp-tender green beans, a comforting meal ready in about 80 minutes.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). In a large bowl, combine ground beef, breadcrumbs, egg, finely diced onion, 1/4 cup milk, 1/4 cup ketchup, 1 teaspoon Worcestershire sauce, 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Mix until just combined, but do not overmix.

Shape the meat mixture into a loaf and place it in a loaf pan or on a foil-lined baking sheet. In a small bowl, whisk together remaining 1/4 cup ketchup, 1 teaspoon Worcestershire sauce, and mustard to create the glaze. Spread the glaze evenly over the top of the meatloaf.
Bake for 50-60 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 160°F (71°C). Let the meatloaf rest for 10 minutes before slicing.

While meatloaf bakes, prepare mashed potatoes: peel and quarter potatoes, boil until tender, then mash with 1/4 cup milk and 1 tablespoon butter, salt, and pepper. Steam or boil green beans until crisp-tender. Serve meatloaf slices with mashed potatoes and green beans.
